import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
# Onemen Bay near Anadyr, Russia
point = ee.Geometry.Point([177.5, 64.7])
roi = point.buffer(5000)  # 5km radius

date1_start = '2025-08-08'
date1_end = '2025-08-10'
date2_start = '2025-09-10'
date2_end = '2025-09-12'

# 2. Data Acquisition
def mask_s2_clouds(image):
    qa = image.select('QA60')
    cloud_mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 10).eq(0).And(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 11).eq(0))
    return image.updateMask(cloud_mask)

def add_ndvi(image):
    ndvi = image.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI')
    return image.addBands(ndvi)

# August 9, 2025
col1 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') \
    .filterBounds(roi) \
    .filterDate(date1_start, date1_end) \
    .map(mask_s2_clouds) \
    .map(add_ndvi)

size1 = col1.size().getInfo()
print(f"August 9 images: {size1}")

if size1 == 0:
    # Try Landsat 9
    col1 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2') \
        .filterBounds(roi) \
        .filterDate(date1_start, date1_end)
    size1 = col1.size().getInfo()
    print(f"August 9 Landsat images: {size1}")
    if size1 == 0:
        print("No data for August 9, 2025")
        print("<answer>C1</answer>")
        exit()

# September 11, 2025
col2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') \
    .filterBounds(roi) \
    .filterDate(date2_start, date2_end) \
    .map(mask_s2_clouds) \
    .map(add_ndvi)

size2 = col2.size().getInfo()
print(f"September 11 images: {size2}")

if size2 == 0:
    # Try Landsat 9
    col2 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2') \
        .filterBounds(roi) \
        .filterDate(date2_start, date2_end)
    size2 = col2.size().getInfo()
    print(f"September 11 Landsat images: {size2}")
    if size2 == 0:
        print("No data for September 11, 2025")
        print("<answer>C1</answer>")
        exit()

# 3. Processing
img1 = col1.median().select('NDVI')
img2 = col2.median().select('NDVI')

# Check pixel counts
count1 = img1.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
    geometry=roi,
    scale=1000,
    maxPixels=1e9
).get('NDVI').getInfo()

count2 = img2.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
    geometry=roi,
    scale=1000,
    maxPixels=1e9
).get('NDVI').getInfo()

print(f"August valid pixels: {count1}")
print(f"September valid pixels: {count2}")

if count1 == 0 or count2 == 0:
    print("No valid pixels after masking")
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    exit()

# 4. Calculate mean NDVI
ndvi1 = img1.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
    geometry=roi,
    scale=1000,
    maxPixels=1e9
).get('NDVI').getInfo()

ndvi2 = img2.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
    geometry=roi,
    scale=1000,
    maxPixels=1e9
).get('NDVI').getInfo()

# 5. Validation & Final Answer
print(f"August 9 mean NDVI: {ndvi1}")
print(f"September 11 mean NDVI: {ndvi2}")

if ndvi1 is None or ndvi2 is None:
    print("NDVI calculation failed")
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
elif ndvi1 < -1 or ndvi1 > 1 or ndvi2 < -1 or ndvi2 > 1:
    print("Invalid NDVI range")
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
elif ndvi1 > ndvi2:
    print("More vegetation in August than September")
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("Not more vegetation in August")
    print("<answer>B</answer>")

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
# Onemen Bay near Anadyr, Russia
point = ee.Geometry.Point([177.5, 64.7])
roi = point.buffer(5000)  # 5km radius

date1_start = '2025-08-08'
date1_end = '2025-08-10'
date2_start = '2025-09-10'
date2_end = '2025-09-12'

# 2. Data Acquisition with less aggressive cloud masking
def mask_s2_clouds_light(image):
    qa = image.select('QA60')
    # Only mask dense clouds (bit 10), not cirrus (bit 11)
    cloud_mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 10).eq(0)
    return image.updateMask(cloud_mask)

def add_ndvi_s2(image):
    ndvi = image.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI')
    return image.addBands(ndvi)

def mask_landsat9_clouds(image):
    qa = image.select('QA_PIXEL')
    cloud_mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0).And(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0))
    return image.updateMask(cloud_mask).multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2)

def add_ndvi_l9(image):
    ndvi = image.normalizedDifference(['SR_B5', 'SR_B4']).rename('NDVI')
    return image.addBands(ndvi)

# Try August 9 with Sentinel-2
col1 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') \
    .filterBounds(roi) \
    .filterDate(date1_start, date1_end) \
    .map(mask_s2_clouds_light) \
    .map(add_ndvi_s2)

img1 = col1.median().select('NDVI')
count1 = img1.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
    geometry=roi,
    scale=1000,
    maxPixels=1e9
).get('NDVI').getInfo()

print(f"Aug S2 imgs: {col1.size().getInfo()}, pixels: {count1}")

# If no valid pixels, try Landsat 9
if count1 == 0:
    col1_l9 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2') \
        .filterBounds(roi) \
        .filterDate(date1_start, date1_end) \
        .map(mask_landsat9_clouds) \
        .map(add_ndvi_l9)
    
    if col1_l9.size().getInfo() > 0:
        img1 = col1_l9.median().select('NDVI')
        count1 = img1.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
            geometry=roi,
            scale=1000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('NDVI').getInfo()
        print(f"Aug L9 imgs: {col1_l9.size().getInfo()}, pixels: {count1}")

# Try September 11 with Sentinel-2
col2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') \
    .filterBounds(roi) \
    .filterDate(date2_start, date2_end) \
    .map(mask_s2_clouds_light) \
    .map(add_ndvi_s2)

img2 = col2.median().select('NDVI')
count2 = img2.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
    geometry=roi,
    scale=1000,
    maxPixels=1e9
).get('NDVI').getInfo()

print(f"Sep S2 imgs: {col2.size().getInfo()}, pixels: {count2}")

# If no valid pixels, try Landsat 9
if count2 == 0:
    col2_l9 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2') \
        .filterBounds(roi) \
        .filterDate(date2_start, date2_end) \
        .map(mask_landsat9_clouds) \
        .map(add_ndvi_l9)
    
    if col2_l9.size().getInfo() > 0:
        img2 = col2_l9.median().select('NDVI')
        count2 = img2.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
            geometry=roi,
            scale=1000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('NDVI').getInfo()
        print(f"Sep L9 imgs: {col2_l9.size().getInfo()}, pixels: {count2}")

# Check if we have valid data
if count1 == 0 or count2 == 0:
    print("No valid pixels after trying all sources")
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
else:
    # Calculate mean NDVI
    ndvi1 = img1.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry=roi,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('NDVI').getInfo()
    
    ndvi2 = img2.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry=roi,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('NDVI').getInfo()
    
    print(f"Aug NDVI: {ndvi1:.3f}, Sep NDVI: {ndvi2:.3f}")
    
    if ndvi1 is None or ndvi2 is None or ndvi1 < -1 or ndvi1 > 1 or ndvi2 < -1 or ndvi2 > 1:
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    elif ndvi1 > ndvi2:
        print("<answer>A</answer>")
    else:
        print("<answer>B</answer>")
